about: Every package motion-connectors installs, as a consumer outside the repository reaches it. scripts/check_installed_consumer.py checks the prefix for each, and CMakeLists.txt beside this file find_package()s each at the repository's major.minor and links its target. Empty until the first import (docs/roadmap/current.md); a new connector adds its row in the change that creates it, and the first one also puts the installed usd-motion-plugins prefix on the consumer's CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH, because every connector's package finds motionCore.
